text:
rupert: heads-up — deploy-bot just blocked the payments service rollout in eu-west-1 during the release window :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deployment paused for release 2026-03-20T10:13Z. Preflight failure: CRD manifest contains deprecated apiVersion 'apiextensions.k8s.io/v1beta1'. Cluster supports only 'apiextensions.k8s.io/v1' — failing install. Suggestion: override chart.version to 3.0.7 or roll back to previous release.

maya: omg. Was this introduced by the chart bump (3.1.0)?

samir: yes — chart 3.1.0 added a CRD update that still uses v1beta1. Helm applied a dry-run and k8s rejected it.

irene: change window is open for another 45m. Do we want to force a short hotfix or hold and pin the chart back? We need SLA for customers on this rollout.

samir: quick option: set --set chart.version=3.0.7 in the release job to proceed. That matches the previous chart and skips the CRD change. Command: ```helm upgrade payments ./charts/payments --namespace payments --version 3.0.7 --reuse-values```

rupert: risks? any migration/backwards incompatibilities if we pin to 3.0.7 for this window?

maya: 3.1.0 only adds a validation field to the CRD. No runtime behavior change. Pinning is safe for now. We should still patch the chart upstream.

alex: I'll assemble release notes and call out the CRD change. If we pin, notes should say: "postponed CRD validation in 3.1.0 due to cluster compatibility; will ship in next maintenance window once CRD uses v1."

irene: ops decision: hold automated canary and apply manual override to pin to 3.0.7 for the scheduled rollout. samir, can you run the override and watch the canary?

samir: doing it now. Running: ```deploy-bot override release payments --version=3.0.7 --reason="CRD apiVersion incompat with cluster"```

deploy-bot: Override applied. Canary re-queued. Monitoring channels: #eng-oncall and #incidents.

rupert: thanks. alex — please put a short blurb in release notes and add action item to follow up with chart maintainers to convert CRD to v1.

alex: on it. Drafting notes and opening a tracker ticket: PAY-4567. Will ping chart maintainers.

maya: leaving a reminder to add a post-deploy smoke check for CRD manifests in our preflight suite so this surfaces earlier.

rupert: agreed. Good catch by deploy-bot. :thumbsup:
